verdict.rationale: Highnote documents BIN sponsorship-style program management (in-house KYC/KYB, compliance, disputes, ledger, settlement) and a fast path from API key to test-environment simulation ('one key, one endpoint... simulate before you talk to anyone'), plus quick-start templates. However, there is no concrete documented timeline metric (e.g., 'X days from signup to live card') and no independent/hands-on corroboration of actual launch speed. Missing for 10: a documented signup-to-first-live-card time metric, explicit BIN sponsorship/network membership partner details, and independent verification of launch speed claims.
